Container.Name: ucweb
Container.Overview: A web remote for Unfolded Circle Remote 3 and Remote Two. Start and stop activities, use the D-pad, volume and transport buttons, and watch connection, battery and power status live, from a phone or a desktop browser. Sign in with a PIN. After the first start, create an API key on each remote with: docker exec -it ucweb npm run create-key (it asks for each remote's web-configurator PIN), then set the PIN with: docker exec -it ucweb npm run set-pin. Keep it on your LAN: never forward its port to the internet.

Config.Name: Remotes
Config.Description: IP addresses of your remotes, comma separated, for example 192.168.1.20,192.168.1.21.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: API keys (keys/<remote hostname>.key), the PIN hash and the session secret.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI in bridge mode. On a custom network with its own IP the UI is at that IP on port 8080.

Config.Name: Default theme
Config.Description: miyara, pats-blue, original, copper, roon, roon-light, dark-orange, graphite-brass, brookwood or brookwood-light. Each browser can pick its own from the menu.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the config folder. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the config folder. 100 is Unraid's users.
